description: Power generation mix for a zone — the latest breakdown of electricity by source (nuclear, wind, solar, hydro, coal, gas, ...) plus fossil-free and renewable percentages. Pass a zone code (e.g. "US-CAL-CISO", "DE", "FR", "GB") or lat+lon. Example: electricitymaps_power_breakdown({ zone: "FR", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Electricity Maps API key (free trial / developer tier at electricitymaps.com)

lat.description: Latitude (use with lon instead of zone)

lon.description: Longitude (use with lat instead of zone)

zone.description: Grid zone code, e.g. "US-CAL-CISO" (California ISO), "DE" (Germany), "FR" (France), "GB" (Great Britain). Alternatively pass lat + lon.

name: electricitymaps_power_breakdown
title: Electricitymaps Power Breakdown
